data_description.panel_host: IP address of your Qolsys IQ Panel on the local network
data_description.panel_token: 6-digit token from Panel Settings > Advanced Settings > 3rd Party Connections

data_description.panel_user_code: 4-6 digit code used when sending disarm commands to the panel. Leave blank to use the code entered in HA.
data_description.ha_user_code: If set, HA validates this code before forwarding to the panel.
data_description.code_arm_required: Require a code in HA UI to arm the alarm
data_description.code_disarm_required: Require a code in HA UI to disarm the alarm
data_description.code_trigger_required: Require a code in HA UI to trigger the alarm

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to panel. Check host, port, and token.
